scope.newReferencesOnly: Ordinary views, after exact age 1 and before age 5.6 years.

primarySource.title: Reference intervals of inhibin B in Chinese children on chemiluminescence analyzer
primarySource.review: Complete primary PDF and full XML independently reviewed by source agents. This evidence distinguishes the source facts from application routing.

locations.medians: Table 2, PDF page 3 and Table 3, PDF page 6

supplement.content: Only Table S1 regression models; no additional age-group medians or definition of exact-age-5 allocation.
supplement.notActivated: Female cubic fit R-squared 0.198 is not a median model and is not used as one.

exclusions: Reproductive diseases, including precocious puberty and delayed sexual development
Chronic diseases, including tumour and tuberculosis
Endocrine diseases, including diabetes, hyperthyroidism and obesity
Neonatal respiratory distress syndrome, jaundice or shock
limitations: Possible residual pathology despite source exclusions; not an unselected community cohort.
All age/sex groups below 120 participants; selected female groups N=60 and N=77.
No time of sampling; source notes diurnal variability.
Adolescent Tanner stage and menstrual-cycle state not identified.
No confirmation that all individuals were untreated; broad labels do not define exact observed age endpoints.

assay.sourceBelowLodHandling: LOD divided by sqrt(2); this is not applied to patient values.
assay.traceabilityCaution: Source statement of traceability to WHO 96/784 does not establish a conversion to Gen II, Oxford ELISA or plasma.

statisticMeaning: The reported 50th quantile of the entire published group; not a median of an exact age, Tanner stage or narrower application subgroup. The 90% CI describes uncertainty in the median estimate, not the patient reference interval.

female1to5LowerLimit.action: No laboratory reference intervals activated; no choice between discrepant lower limits required for a median-only comparison.

sourceDiscrepanciesNotActivated.otherHormones: Unrelated hormone table inconsistencies are not imported.
sourceDiscrepanciesNotActivated.ageBoundaries: Printed 1–5 and 5–10 group labels do not explicitly define inclusive/exclusive age boundaries.

qualification.exactAgeFiveAssignment: Higher group as an explicit application convention; not an author-provided endpoint rule.
qualification.exactFirstBirthday: Existing Ljubicic reference and term-birth conditions preserved.
qualification.unknownAssayOrSpecimen: Allows qualified orientational comparison without confirming compatibility.
qualification.knownIncompatible: Gen II, Oxford ELISA, other platforms, generic CLIA without this assay, plasma or other material do not qualify.
qualification.otherGates: Existing contraindication, result-censoring and unit gates remain.
qualification.tanner: No new Tanner requirement, no inferred Th1 or CPP diagnosis from Th2.
qualification.fallback: No use of Zhou outside its app domain as a replacement for an incompatible existing source.

presentation.interpretation: Changes in group reference at age 5 or source at 5.6 are not abrupt biological events. Do not reshape the smooth bridge to fit these numbers.

beforeFemale: Ljubicic model [0.02,1] years with infant qualification
remainingFemaleGaps: A possible age span crossing source/group boundaries; no midpoint selection
Known context incompatible with a source
coverageBeforeAndAfter.male: No changes to ordinary models, separate group summaries, source boundaries or points.
coverageBeforeAndAfter.sexComparisons: No changes; new Zhou profiles are ordinaryOnly and do not enter minipuberty or puberty sex comparisons.
coverageBeforeAndAfter.coverageMeaning: Potential source availability, not universal patient eligibility or a single harmonized continuous model.

preserved: All 74 pre-existing patient-point profiles and their source numbers
Female illustrative curves, smooth childhood bridge, scales and zoom geometry
Laboratory reference intervals, interpretations, units and reference-range axes
Forms, patient fields, snapshots, histories and storage
Male references, infant source conditions and sex-comparison models

validation.status: Pre-publication source and implementation verification snapshot. Completed controls are recorded below; final full E2E and exact-head GitHub CI results are reported in the pull request.

independentCoverage.scope: Isolated base compared against current working-tree production functions; not a claim of full browser suite or final committed-head CI success.

postMergeIntegrationReview.sourceReport: coverage/post-merge-review.json and post-merge-age-probes.json in external task artifacts
postMergeIntegrationReview.conclusion: The new base modifies measurement-age consumers of growth calculations; it leaves laboratory age normalizers, source adapters and the converter logic byte-identical. Prior inhibin reference-age coverage conclusions remain applicable.
postMergeIntegrationReview.scope: Read-only merge integration controls and age probes; not a second complete coverage-matrix execution or full browser suite.

pwaUpdateAndOfflineRestart.sourceReport: pwa/run.log and its detailed run artifacts outside repository
pwaUpdateAndOfflineRestart.scope: Actual service-worker update and fresh browser restart; not merely reuse of an already-open page.

releaseValidationReporting.location: Pull request for the current branch and latest exact head SHA
required: Wait for every GitHub check after each push and fix failures
Keep final PWA and CI details in pull request
releaseValidationReporting.reason: Source documentation records stable verification facts; final CI statuses are not committed merely to refresh status text and trigger another CI cycle.

rights: No PDF, figure or full source text is redistributed. Factual table extraction and cryptographic hashes support provenance.

independentImplementationReview.status: No material finding in source data, routing policy, generator or renderer diff.
reviewed: Published source rows, N, median CI, assay and caveats match the reviewed primary source.
Constant whole-group profiles preserve original source-group labels and exclusive/ inclusive app bounds.
Generator checks non-overlap with earlier profiles, preventing fallback to new source on method mismatch.
Renderer labels group median and keeps source point separate from curve; ordinaryOnly and comparison domains prevent new sex-comparison points.
independentImplementationReview.limits: Read-only review of current working tree; no extra browser or full test execution claimed by documentation reviewer.
